items.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...you were on that original recording, is that right? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes.

ctx.x: Tom Porrello has played trumpet with a lengthy list of artists, including Stan Kenton, Elvis Presley, Harry James, and Lady Gaga. He was a first-call player in Las Vegas, playing as many as six shows a day, and in 2023 he is still an active musician. As a lead trumpeter, he is known for his endurance and consistency in reaching the upper limits of the instrument.
Tom was interviewed via Zoom on March 6, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
